label.en: Grand Minister of Agriculture Palace Assistant

translationRepairs: Jia Yi's argument influenced symbolic imperial plowing to promote agriculture.
Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened the imperial plow-fields, and personally plowed to encourage the people.
上感誼言，始開籍田，躬耕以勸百姓 makes the emperor the agent who was moved, opened the plow-fields, and personally plowed; the prior idiomatic erases that agency and invents 'symbolic' plowing.
The throne accepted this advice and granted a substantial tax reduction.
The emperor again followed his words and issued an edict remitting half of the people's rent and tax in the twelfth year.
下詔賜民十二年租稅之半 specifies an edict remitting half the people's rent-tax in year twelve; 'substantial tax reduction' drops both the half measure and the year.
Late in reign, Emperor Wu signaled policy reversal by honoring 'enrich the people' governance.
Late in Emperor Wu's reign, he regretted the campaigns and then enfeoffed the Chancellor as Marquis of Enriching the People.
悔征伐之事，乃封丞相為富民侯 states regret for the campaigns and the chancellor's enfeoffment as Marquis of Enriching the People; the prior idiomatic invents a vague policy gloss and omits that enfeoffment.
Zhao Guo was appointed to implement grain-oriented agrarian reform.
He appointed Zhao Guo as Commandant for Grain Collection.
以趙過為搜粟都尉 is a concrete office appointment as Commandant for Grain Collection; the prior idiomatic invents a reform paraphrase and drops the title.
Where draft animals were scarce, officials adapted by introducing human-drawn plows.
Some people suffered from too few oxen and had no way to hurry cultivation, so Pingdu magistrate Guang taught Guo human-drawn plowing.
平都令光教過以人輓犁 names Pingdu magistrate Guang teaching Guo human-drawn plowing; the prior idiomatic erases both persons for an anonymous official adaptation.
The adaptation was institutionalized through cooperative labor-pull arrangements.
Guo recommended Guang as assistant and taught the people to hire one another to pull plows.
過奏光以為丞，教民相與庸輓犁 has Guo recommend Guang as assistant and teach mutual hired plow-pulling; the prior idiomatic erases the named recommendation.
“Then Grand Agriculture vice-director Geng Shouchang, skilled in calculation and discussing utility, favored by the emperor, memorialized in Wufeng period:
Then Grand Agriculture vice-director Geng Shouchang, skilled in calculation and discussing utility, favored by the emperor, memorialized in the Wufeng period:
The Chinese opens with narrative 時…五鳳中奏言：「 before the quoted memorial; a leading English quotation mark on this framing sentence is unwarranted and should be removed.
“Then Grand Agriculture vice-director Geng Shouchang, skilled in calculation and discussing utility, favored by the emperor, memorialized in Wufeng period:
Then Grand Agriculture vice-director Geng Shouchang, skilled in calculation and discussing utility, favored by the emperor, memorialized in the Wufeng period:
Same framing sentence as the idiomatic: 奏言：「 begins the quote after this clause, so the literal should not open with a stray leading quotation mark.
He claimed direct state extraction had previously reduced fish supply, reversed when access returned to private fishers.
Elders all say that in Emperor Wu's time, when the county offices themselves fished, sea fish did not appear; later, when fishing was returned to the people, the fish then appeared.
長老皆言武帝時縣官嘗自漁…後復予民，魚乃出 is elders' report dated to Emperor Wu's time about county offices fishing then restoring fishing to the people; the prior idiomatic drops that attribution and dating.
